_meta.description: Tenders and contract packages for Line 12. Values in crore INR. MMRDA's site lists only current notices, so most entries come from trade press (status 'reported'). 'tender_status' is floated, bids_opened, awarded, cancelled or unknown.

tenders.scope: General Consultant for Metro Lines 10 and 12 (design review, supervision, safety, quality and contract management for civil and systems work)
tenders.awarded_value_note: Winning bid for both lines together. Wikipedia gives Rs 183.53 crore, probably the Line 12 share, but no source for that split was found.

tenders.package: Detailed Design Consultant (package number not found)
tenders.duration_note: Two years from 1 November 2023, per MMRDA statement reported by Free Press Journal (Dec 2024).

tenders.scope: Elevated viaduct and 9 stations, Kalyan to Kolegaon (ch. -13.383 m to +10,043.275 m)
tenders.notes: Cancelled June 2023 for scope changes; replaced by CA-240.

tenders.scope: Elevated viaduct and 8 stations, Kolegaon to Taloja (ch. +10,043.275 m to +20,400 m)
tenders.notes: Cancelled June 2023 for scope changes; replaced by CA-240.

tenders.scope: Part design and construction of elevated viaduct (ch. -860.224 m to +21,316.022 m) and 19 elevated stations, Kalyan to Amandoot, plus depot connecting line
tenders.contract_period_reported: 1 April 2024 to 30 September 2026 (MMRDA statement reported by Free Press Journal, Dec 2024). Progress in Aug 2026 shows this period will be exceeded.

tenders.scope: Rolling stock, CBTC signalling, telecom, traction and power supply, depot equipment, lifts, escalators and other systems, with a 2-year defect liability period and 5 years of maintenance
tenders.notes: The package number CA-315 and an EMD of Rs 24.40 crore appeared only in a search snippet from a paywalled page; treat both as unverified. Bidders not known yet.
